name: Kedamono no Arashi
source:
A happy wedded life with a beautiful and gentle wife, Yui.
However, their peaceful life is destructed by a flirtatious and shifty man.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ065426?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
与美丽温柔的妻子结衣过着幸福的婚姻生活。
然而，他们平静的生活却被一个风骚狡诈的男人破坏了。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ065426?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
